name: @qu/app-shell
description: Qu V5 App Shell: the minimal, application-agnostic bootstrap kernel (docs/app-shell-arbeitsauftrag.md §3/§4) that a Relay serves as its whole static app. identity.js generates/loads a browser identity and joins a relay's Space; boot.js runs the boot sequence (identity -> Space -> @qu/app-core's AppRuntime -> @qu/app-renderer render, on every hash route change); shell.js is the single <qu-app-shell> custom element index.html mounts - a DOM marker + lifecycle hook, not a component system. Knows no concrete page, template, or application; everything else is loaded from the Qu Space.
